rubric: 30 too few for stable rates|wide uncertainty

grow test set from pilot logs

question: How would you evaluate a RAG system before putting it into production?

mustCover: representative test set with expected answers and supporting passages
include unanswerable, stale-version and restricted-access cases
retrieval metrics: recall@k or hit rate, context relevance
generation metrics: faithfulness, answer relevance, correctness, citation accuracy, abstention accuracy
thresholds set before running, used as a release gate
strongSignals: zero tolerance for permission leakage on the test set
re-runs on every prompt, model, chunking or embedding change
names RAGAS and what it measures
redFlags: no unanswerable questions in the test set
trusts automated judge scores without calibration
